qualification: Pre-fix Worker::drain_commands in src/playback/runtime/thread.rs cleared `self.ended = false` on Command::Seek and Command::Rewind but did not set `self.ended = true` when `reader.seek_raw` returned `Ok(None)` or `Err(error)` or when `reader.rewind` returned `Err(error)`, and did not update `self.indexed_count` inside `stage()`, causing the worker thread to immediately resume `decode_next()` in the same generation after emitting a terminal seek/rewind event; and crates/fvid-media/src/owned_play_controls_impl.rs misrouted ASS documents containing `-->` in comments or dialogue text to `parse_srt`, failed to scope ASS `Dialogue:` lines to `[Events]`, overflowed `i32` coordinates in `blit_bitmap_subtitle`, overflowed 32-bit `width * height` in `detect_letterbox_bars`, `waveform_column_fills`, `apply_box_denoise_pixel`, and `apply_unsharp_pixel`, and could exceed `max_w`/`max_h` in `fit_window_to_video` and `locked_window_size`.

Updating src/playback/runtime/thread.rs marks `self.ended = true` and synchronizes `cache_packets`/`indexed_count` on seek/rewind EOF or error; updating crates/fvid-media/src/owned_play_controls_impl.rs detects ASS headers before checking `-->`, scopes `Dialogue:` parsing to `[Events]`, widens coordinates to `i64` with checked buffer bounds in `blit_bitmap_subtitle`, uses `usize::checked_mul` in pixel/scope helpers, and clamps `fit_window_to_video` and `locked_window_size` to `max_w`/`max_h`.

Synthetic fixtures in tests/fixtures/playback-errors/play-controls/ verify single terminal event emission on seek error without continuing decode, ASS subtitle parsing with `-->` and `[Events]` scoping, overflow-safe bitmap subtitle blitting, and overflow-safe pixel/window helpers.
